id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

sensorName.description: Name of the #sensor to be included in the notification content.

updatedOperationalStatus.description: Operational status of the #sensor to be included in the notification content.

relatedModel.description: Related model of the current notification.

relatedModelName.description: Name of the #relatedModel to be included in the notification content.

resultingFeatureSetCardinality.description: Feature set cardinality of the #relatedModel to be included in the notification content.

relatedAsset.description: Related asset of the current notification.

relatedAssetName.description: Name of the #relatedAsset to be included in the notification content.

trainJob.description:
Train job of the current notification.
If there's a failure that prevents the model from retraining, the job will be empty

trainJobName.description: Name of the #trainJob to be included in the notification content.

jobStatus.description:
The most recent job status of the current notification. This object will be updated at run time only if the train
job exists in order to update the latest status of the job.

author.description: Author of the current notification, it refers to the user who triggered the operating status update.

authorName.description: Name of the #author to be included in the notification content.

timestamp.description: The time of creation of the current notification

isTest.description:
Flag that indicates whether a notification instance is intended for testing purposes only. When set to true, the
notification should be treated as a test notification and not processed or displayed in the production environment.

title:
Type that represents a section of the {@link ReliabilityEmailUpdateNotificationScheduler} corresponding to the
{@link FaultySensor} module.
name: FaultySensor.Notification
